Frequently asked questions
Go to help center

Directs to Airalo help center for more support information.

Install as soon as you’d like — just make sure you have stable internet connection. You can install in advance if you’re outside the coverage area— when you arrive, you can connect to use your package. Read article
When you're in the eSIM's coverage area, you can connect to a mobile network to use your eSIM. You'll need to make sure the eSIM is on and selected for data (or calls and texts, if included with your eSIM). Read article
In many cases, you can top up your eSIM — you don't need to buy a new eSIM to stay connected. When available, you'll find top-up packages for your eSIM before and after purchase. Read article
With renewals, you can automatically renew your package when your eSIM has 10% data remaining — turn renewals on and off from your eSIM’s details. Read article
